column1: # Game profile of Catherine: Full Body (Switch, base game v0 + update 1.0.1a = v131072). In bring-up
# Atlus's GFD engine (the game's code name xrd758) on SDK 8.2.1, NVN; modules main + subsdk0 (GLSLC, the runtime shader compiler) + subsdk1 (NintendoSDK_movie) + sdk.
# RomFS: everything in five CRI CPK archives (data/Base.cpk, Model.cpk, Puzzle.cpk, Keyfree.cpk, Patch.cpk), CRI ADX2 sound (data/sound*/*.acb / .awb) and CRI Sofdec2 movies
# (data/movie*/*.usm, H.264 decoded through the SDK's movie::Decoder, hle_movie.c).
# Shaders: GLSLC outputs, one stage each: 3,050 in data/shaders_binary (*.vs / *.ps), 76 in main, and 2 the game compiles at boot with its own GLSLC from GLSL sources in main
# (captured on the Mac, hle_glslc.c). Its GLSLC (GPU code version 1.15) writes shader type 0 into every vertex shader's SPH (shader_split.py sph_stage)

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)
# only the merged 1.0.1a copy is extracted; the base game's own build IDs are added when needed
# load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk*, sdk (subsdk0 = GLSLC, subsdk1 = NintendoSDK_movie)
# The NPDM declares no system resource (META +0x14 = 0): nninitStartup sets a heap of the pool − 64 MB (3.11 GB), and main's bss is 48 MB. The 4 GB block of the other games
# without virtual address memory (256 MB in front + 256 MB alias region + 256 MB stack region + 3.25 GB heap region)
# The rewritten modules take 92 MB (main 61 MB with its bss, GLSLC 9.5 MB, the movie library 7.6 MB, sdk 13.8 MB), more than the default 64 MB of used memory, so SetHeapSize(pool − 64 MB)
# failed and the game ran on a 32 MB heap until a 96 MB memory pool's storage came back null (main+0x2eb954). 96 MB, as the NSP script's guess after the rewrite
# ---- Shader split (shader_split.py; GLSLC outputs in loose RomFS files, main and the run-time capture) ----
